title: Rhythmic Movement Activity
description: Explore rhythmic movement activities – those activities that require us to use our bodies in coordinated ways, often in time to music. Topics include rhythmic body movement, gymnastics, drumming, dance, skipping, marching, aerobics etc. Focuses on skill development and how to lead rhythmic movement activities in future school and community settings.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EPHE 439, EDUC 445, PE 439.
